company.name: Nepal Micro Insurance Company Limited
company.headquarters: Maharjan Complex, Bhrikuti Path, Bharatpur, Chitwan
company.about: Nepal Micro Insurance is a micro non-life insurer that says it was the first of its kind to get an operating licence in Nepal. It offers low-cost vehicle, property, theft and accident cover mainly to small customers. Premiums can be paid through eSewa and ConnectIPS.
highlights: Micro non-life insurer with 27 branches and counters
1,199 claims paid worth about NPR 8.8 crore in FY 2082/83 (unconfirmed)
Reinsured with Himalayan Re and Nepal Reinsurance

policies.name: Two-Wheeler Insurance
policies.summary: Cover for your motorbike or scooter against damage to others and, depending on the option, your own bike.
features: Third-party liability as per NIA tariff
Buy online and pay by eSewa or ConnectIPS
exclusions: Driving under the influence of alcohol

pricing.note: Indicative third-party premium for a 150cc-250cc bike; check NIA tariff

bestFor: Bike and scooter owners needing the legal minimum cover

policies.name: Private Vehicle Insurance
policies.summary: Covers your private car or jeep against accident damage, fire and theft, plus liability to others.
features: Comprehensive option based on vehicle value
benefits: Repair cost or total loss payout for own vehicle
bestFor: Private car owners wanting comprehensive cover

policies.name: Accidental Micro Insurance (incl. Student Secure Plan)
policies.summary: Low-cost cover that pays if you die or are disabled in an accident.
features: Student Secure Plan available for school students
Corporate Secure Plan available for groups

pricing.note: Indicative; actual premium depends on plan chosen

policies.name: Property and Burglary/Theft Micro Insurance
policies.summary: Protects your home, shop or goods against fire, theft and similar losses.
features: Suited to small households and shops
benefits: Compensation for loss or damage to insured property
Payout for theft or burglary loss
exclusions: Loss from war or nuclear risks
Losses from dishonest acts of the insured
